# Embraix

> Africa's platform for clean energy, electric vehicles, and smart technology — guides, products, expert services, and free AI consultations.

Embraix helps consumers, professionals, and installers across Africa adopt clean energy and sustainable technology through editorial content, a curated product store, an expert marketplace, and an AI consultation assistant.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the Embraix platform.
- [Explore](/explore): Discover featured content, products, and services.
- [AI Consult](/chat): Free AI-powered consultations on clean energy and EVs.
- [Newsletter](/newsletter): Weekly updates on clean energy and sustainability.
- [Promotions](/promotions): Current deals on clean energy products.

## Media

- [Media Hub](/media): Articles, stories, guides, and reviews.
- [Blog](/blog): Editorial articles on clean energy and smart tech.
- [News](/news): Community news and discussions.
- [Stories & Voices](/media/stories): Real-world case studies and project impact stories.
- [DIY Guides](/media/diy-guides): Practical do-it-yourself guides.

## Store

- [Store Hub](/store): Catalog of solar, batteries, EVs, and smart tech.
- [All Products](/store/products): Browse the full product catalog.
- [Compare](/store/compare): Side-by-side product comparison.

## Centre

- [Centre Hub](/centre): Service marketplace for installers and providers.
- [Browse Services](/centre/browse): Find local certified providers.
- [Expert Marketplace](/centre/experts): Directory of energy experts.

## Insight

- [Insight Hub](/insight): Research, reports, and intelligence.
- [Industry Reports](/insight/reports): Market analysis and trends.
- [Whitepapers](/insight/whitepapers): Technical research documents.
- [Research Publications](/insight/research): Community research library.
